nearest_work_correction: Do not claim the first use of a Lyapunov bound to design resources or learning rates. Perazzone already combines a convergence bound with Lyapunov client/power control; Gupta designs adaptive rates; Yu optimizes worker activation/staleness. The revised contrast is the specific covariance/Markov-spacing/step/affordable-horizon objective and conditional learning-value admission interface.
